newsitem.title: USA: Owens-Illinois acquires Anchor Glass Assets.
newsitem.headline: Owens-Illinois acquires Anchor Glass Assets.

text.p: Owens-Illinois Inc Wednesday said it completed the acquisition of certain assets of Anchor Glass Container Corp, for about $125 million plus the assumption of certain liabilities.

Owens-Illinois has acquired Anchor's glass container manufacturing plants in Antioch and Hayward, Calif., and will assume Anchor's contractual agreements with Adolph Coors Co's Coors Brewing Co, including a partnership interest in the Rocky Mountain Bottle Co.

As announced on December 12, 1996, Owens-Illinois agreed to acquire these Anchor assets agreement was part of a joint bid by Consumers Packaging Inc and Owens-Illinois, under which Consumers agreed to purchase the majority of Anchor's assets.
Consumers Packaging's portion of the acquisition also has been completed.
